verdicts.reason: Both break up the SALE lantern stack in the same way. The S and A float apart from it, the L shrinks to a tiny glyph jammed against the E, and the white circles are left empty. The lanterns and clouds are crushed into unreadable clumps, so the brand motif is lost and the word doesn't read. B has a slightly larger headline but pushes the L/E collision tighter against the right canvas edge, so A is marginally less bad.
